description: Run by the renovate repo's workflow (the global config, and default.json for the shared settings). Every update is a PR, nothing automerges: applies are deliberate.

customManagers.description: Versions with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment on the line above (lint.yml, the roles' defaults)
Terraform variables with a `# renovate:` comment above the block (talos_version, kubernetes_version)

packageRules.description: The Terraform CLI: required_version in every root and lint.yml
prBodyNotes: Apply with the new version from the workstation and mgmt (and CI's, once it applies).

packageRules.description: Talos and Kubernetes: one minor version at a time, applied by hand
prBodyNotes: Upgrades the cluster when applied (`./build.sh clusters`). Bump talosctl/kubectl in tools-bin's `context-setup` too, and for Kubernetes `KUBERNETES_VERSION` (and the schemas commit) in iac-k8s's lint.yml. Check the Talos support matrix first.
15.0 is the LTS line (until July 2027): a new major leaves it. Check the binary's .asc against the Forgejo release key, then `forgejo.yml`.

packageRules.description: Leaving the LTS line is a decision: a new major only gets a PR once ticked in the Dependency Dashboard

prBodyNotes: Check the zip's SHA256SUMS signature against HashiCorp's key, take a Raft snapshot, then `vault.yml`.
